data.name: Arc Strike VR
data.detailed_description:
ArcStrike VR is a VR action game that emphasizes real physical movement and strategic judgment. In addition to controllers, this game can also be played using hand tracking, and supports Quest series VR headsets.

Core Mechanics & Features:

  • Life is Space Your health is visualized as the blue matrix beneath your feet. Every loss of health means the shrinking of your safe zone and active movement area. Once both feet step outside the matrix boundaries, it's an immediate game over! Try your best to pick up items from the conveyor belt to restore your health~

  • Two-Color Strategy Against enemy magic barrages, here's a little secret: you can actually block them by clashing magic orbs. You can summon left or right shields of the corresponding colors using gestures to block attacks for a period of time. However, the magic shield will also block your own magic orbs of the same color! The number of times you can use the shield must also be obtained from the conveyor belt~

  • Dynamic Threats In addition to ranged-attack enemies, "suicide enemies" also lurk on the battlefield. You must destroy them before they step into your health matrix; otherwise, you will suffer massive damage. Additionally, enemy magic orbs can also damage other enemies. Adjusting your position from time to time might allow you to use their own attacks against them...

How to Play:

To deploy the energy shield, naturally open your palm and face it toward yourself for 2 seconds, or press and hold the controller's side grip button for 2 seconds.

To fire an attacking magic orb, first make a fist (with the back of your hand facing yourself) and then quickly open your fingers, or press the front trigger on the controller.

Developer Note: To play in Hand Tracking mode, you must activate a Meta Horizon developer account beforehand!

data.short_description: In ArcStrike VR, you’ll need to dodge enemy "bullet hell" attacks from all directions—front, back, left, and right—while collecting items, as well as fire your own barrages and deploy shields for defense. This game is played using your hands, feet, and a VR headset.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus
